what_its_for: Benzonatate is used to relieve a dry, non-productive cough. It works by numbing the stretch receptors in your lungs and airways that trigger the urge to cough, helping you feel more comfortable.
how_to_take: Swallow the capsule whole with a full glass of water. Do NOT chew, crush, suck on, or break open the capsule. The liquid inside the capsule can numb your mouth and throat very quickly, which can cause serious problems like choking or a dangerous reaction. Take it exactly as your doctor prescribed.
dosing: The usual adult dose is 100 mg to 200 mg taken 3 times a day, as needed, up to a maximum of 600 mg per day. Do not take more than your doctor prescribed. Always follow your doctor's specific instructions for your dose.
missed_dose: If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it is almost time for your next scheduled dose, skip the missed dose and continue with your regular schedule. Do NOT double up or take two doses at the same time to make up for a missed one.
storage: Store at room temperature, between 68°F and 77°F (20°C to 25°C). Keep the capsules in a dry place away from heat, moisture, and direct light. Keep the container tightly closed and store all medications safely out of reach of children and pets. Never store in the bathroom. Do not use after the expiration date on the label.
what_to_avoid: Do NOT chew, crush, or break the capsules — this is the most important thing to avoid. Do not drink alcohol while taking benzonatate, as it can increase drowsiness. Avoid driving, operating heavy machinery, or doing activities that require alertness until you know how this medication affects you. Do not give this medication to children under 10 years of age, as it can be life-threatening in young children.
when_to_call_doctor: Call your doctor or get emergency help right away if you experience: numbness or tingling in your mouth or throat (especially if you accidentally chewed a capsule), difficulty breathing or swallowing, chest tightness, extreme dizziness or confusion, feeling like you might pass out, severe allergic reaction (rash, hives, swelling of the face or throat), or if your cough does not improve or gets worse after 7 days. Seek emergency help immediately if a child swallows a capsule — this is a medical emergency.
when_it_works: Benzonatate usually starts working within 15 to 20 minutes after taking a dose. The effects typically last for 3 to 8 hours. It helps reduce the urge to cough but does not treat the underlying cause of your cough, such as an infection.
special_populations: Children: This medication should NOT be given to children under 10 years of age. Accidental ingestion in young children can be fatal — even one capsule can be life-threatening. Keep out of reach of children at all times. Pregnancy and Breastfeeding: Tell your doctor if you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding before taking this medication. Older adults: Use with caution, as older adults may be more sensitive to the drowsiness side effect. Kidney or liver problems: Tell your doctor if you have kidney or liver disease before taking this medication.
